reviewType: Visual inspection of generated images in the conversation, followed by file-integrity verification
scope: Sixteen selected concept reference sheets for Player, Bot01, Bot02 and Bot03

requirements.requirement: All four approved characters have separate references

requirements.evidence: Eight labeled directions per character: front, front-right, right, back-right, back, back-left, left, front-left
requirements.result: visually checked; duplicated and reversed directions corrected

requirements.evidence: Four Head sheets, four Details sheets and four guided Axial sheets: crown/under-jaw, high/low body, full-body top/bottom, glove palm/back, boot outer/inner/top/sole, chest/back and waist front/back
requirements.result: covered as concept inspections with camera-guided poles; not calibrated final shared-mesh projections

requirements.requirement: Approved identities, style and major costume features preserved
requirements.evidence: Compared against Approved-Concept.png and cross-checked head/detail sheets against each character turnaround
requirements.result: qualitatively reviewed; new unseen surfaces proposed for creator review

requirements.evidence: Bot01 single right-thigh holster; Bot03 right locs/left cropped temple and right long/left copper-edged short thigh panel; player outer/inner right-boot distinction
requirements.result: visually reviewed; fixed side rules recorded in MODELING-GUIDE.md

requirements.evidence: Final PNGs, offline viewer, modeling guide, prompts, manifest and verified ZIP

requirements.requirement: Headless work and unchanged runtime assets
requirements.evidence: Image generation, filesystem packaging and Blender background orthographic-guide rendering; no visible Blender/Unity/editor/player/browser windows launched for this reference task

corrections: Bot01 front-left figure changed to the opposite cheek/direction; near-side left thigh kept free of a second holster; bottom-right figure scale aligned.
Bot03 body right/left profiles swapped into correct cells; front-right quarter direction corrected; fixed anatomical side of locs/cropped temple retained.
Bot03 large left-head view changed from two-eye three-quarter portrait to one-eye left profile.
Player inner right boot redrawn from the opposite side; BODY TOP/BOTTOM detail labels replaced with HIGH/LOW ANGLE to match actual views.

Selected full-body axial sheets follow headless true-pole camera guides. Corrected rough-guide shoulder interiors, underside palms, side tags, Bot01/Bot03 sole orientation and Bot02 accidental player-style ivory tread inserts.

excludedAttempts.reason: Not true pole projections; perspective/pose and tread drift. Excluded from selected images, viewer and ZIP.
Generation inputs/intermediate corrections, not alternate selected designs.

limits: These are independent generated concept drawings, not renders of one canonical 3D mesh. They do not prove exact geometric or pixel registration.
Newly illustrated hidden backs/soles/palms/underside transitions are design extensions and are not creator-approved yet.
Exact orthographic geometry, fixed physical dimensions and perfect final character quality require subsequent shared-mesh modeling and rendered verification.

approval.finishedModels: not assessed in this reference task
